name: structural-format-emitters-module-move
body:
source: the four durable spine edges `solution.component.structural-format-emitters` —implemented-by→ `rust.structfrontend.walk` / `rust.structfrontend.line_count` / `rust.structfrontend.parse_headings` / `rust.structfrontend.build_doc`, authored while the bundled structural scanner lived in the flat `src/structlib/src/lib.rs`.

Inconsistency: the structlib decomposition (plan `apg-cleanup`, phase-04 task-7 + tasks 233–341) splits the crate into 17 modules. The crate stays lib + bin — the Module `rust.structfrontend` and `rust.structfrontend.main` / `.run` / `.tests*` and `rust.structfrontend-bin.main` are PRESERVED — but every other unit gains a module segment in its Rust FQN. The four anchors this component names move into their own modules, so the old flat FQNs cease to exist and the verifying scan would have shown the authored `implemented-by` targets as drift.

Resolution: re-pointed the four `implemented-by` edges here, before the verifying scan, from the flat FQNs to the already-planned module-segmented FQNs (pending until the decomposition lands; the planned Implementation nodes are kept, no real code authored):
  rust.structfrontend.walk           → rust.structfrontend.discovery.walk
  rust.structfrontend.line_count     → rust.structfrontend.lines.line_count
  rust.structfrontend.parse_headings → rust.structfrontend.md.parse_headings
  rust.structfrontend.build_doc      → rust.structfrontend.md.build_doc
The component body was updated to cite the new `.discovery.`/`.lines.`/`.md.` FQNs. The preserved anchors were left untouched: `solution.container.structural-scanner` —implemented-by→ `rust.structfrontend` (Module), and `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` —implemented-by→ `rust.structfrontend` (Module), `rust.structfrontend.main`, `rust.structfrontend.run`.

Prose survey: the only durable note citing the four flat FQNs is `solution.note.structural-scanner-anchor-relocation`; it is the point-in-time record of the apg-0.17.0 mdlib→structlib re-point (it names task `apg-0.17.0/plan.phase-01.task-14` and reports the anchors as they resolved then), so it is left as historical — the same treatment the java/python/rust reconciliations gave their pre-move prose records. `requirements.note.frontends-are-separate-projects` cites only the preserved `rust.structfrontend.tests.*` FQNs and needs no change. The component body was updated because it is a live contract description, not a change-set record. [with coordinator]
